4D01.scope: 定义概率归一化与形式耦合展开，分开实积分存在性和形式级数。

4D04.scope: 枚举三个配对，计算面循环、指标约束、Tr M^4 及四次耦合一阶项。

4D05.scope: 由带标号连通分量的集合分拆完整证明指数公式；保留顶点符号和归一化。

4D06.scope: 逐耦合次数有限的形式重排；不推出真实积分余项估计。

4D07.scope: 定义向量作用、规范变换和高斯归一化；D-brane 解释另列物理提案。

4D08.scope: 固定味数下逐图证明有边界曲面的 hbar^(2g-2+b) 权重。

4D09.scope: 正定矩阵的归一化复高斯积分与形式 log det 展开逐步计算。

4D0A.scope: 单迹模型固定 t 的逐耦合形式连通估计；不作真实概率的一致误差声明。

4D0B.scope: 按报告 Definition 1.2 区分大 N 鞍点、圆盘阶细化及经典临界点。

4D0C.scope: 双阱临界点和有限块变换计算；未重建规范零模处理或量子鞍点分析。

4D0D.scope: 定义 BRST 上同调、鬼数、幂零性反常；不建立任意场论的重整化。

4D0E.scope: 有限增广 Artinian 系数上的 MC 方程、有限逆和换基符号。

4D0F.scope: 完整计算 H1 切空间与 H2 二阶障碍，验证障碍的换基不变性。

4D10.scope: 矩阵单位交换子显式计算；不由孤立的交换李代数恢复乘法。

4D11.scope: 在完整形式反常映射、全部矩阵大小、分次幂零测试和 q^2=0 假设下读取有序高阶操作；不是仅从零点集重构的定理。

4D12.scope: 完整展开变形态射微分平方，并验证带第三对象的复合 Leibniz 律。

4D13.scope: 有限维严格循环迹的定义与外代数例子；区分 proper、smooth 和非紧 Calabi-Yau 结构。

4D14.scope: 准确引用 Costello Theorem A 的设定和结论；没有重建胞腔证明或弦模空间积分。

4D16.scope: 给出奇偶场、OPE、BRST 归一化与相对复形，明确规范不变及排除未求导 c 零模。

4D17.scope: 球面 K^(1-Delta) 截面的换图和模式数计算；wedge 投影的闭合性为模型中的引用结构。

4D18.scope: 给出 I,J 权重与正反 OPE、总奇偶矩阵乘法，明确非对角介子和单迹混合限制。

4D19.scope: 引用四个零次类的交换与行列式关系；完整模型识别显式要求无对角混合、上同调集中、生成性和无额外关系。

clarifications.detail: All N-power computations are coefficientwise formal unless a positive Gaussian integral is explicitly specified.
sigma=(0123); alpha=(01)(23),(03)(12),(02)(13); faces=3,3,1; Euler=2,2,0; Tr M^4=hbar^2(2N^3+N). Parent supplied numerical regression; local page includes full independent index calculation.
Publisher (1.7) display has a lambda exponent inconsistent with the potential and adjacent prose. Derivative of -x^2/2+lambda*x^4/4 explicitly fixes stationary points at +/-lambda^(-1/2).
Use coordinate-consistent polynomial section basis 0<=r<=2Delta-2; do not silently identify the report's printed Laurent-mode index expression with that basis.
Relative local-operator complex imposes gauge invariance and excludes undifferentiated c; ghost number is distinguished from intrinsic parity. I,J have weight 1/2, ghost number zero and parity p_A.

Four commutative coordinate classes and their determinant relation first yield C_t -> H0(B_t). Full A-infinity model identification requires controlled diagonal mixing, cohomology concentrated in degree zero, generation and absence of further relations.
Unused small-resolution aside removed from elementary fiber page; general conifold transition remains an attributed proposal, not an unproved local geometric equivalence.
Finite-dimensional proper cyclic trace model is not the same as a smooth/noncompact Calabi-Yau category; Costello hypotheses retained.
Conjugate Weyl generators are not declared commuting; global propagator identity retains 1-Pi for cohomology zero modes.

ICM report [41] is described only as in preparation at the time of the report. The later selected Gaiotto–Zeng v2 source is separately identified and actually read for level/coset clarification; no full-paper reading or comprehensive holographic proof claimed.

Other report references, including [35] and broader higher-operation/Chern–Simons/BF literature, were not independently read in full. Their claims remain attributed to report-level discussion; no synthetic theorem contracts invented.
Local Artinian R and nilpotent m bound in 4D12, shift definition linked in 4D13, index/vector loops use 回路. Access and workflow records remain here rather than in public mathematical prose.
